agent.summary: The personal site of Jacob Wiltshire (rcn.sh): a short bio, writing on software, live Spotify listening data, public GitHub activity, and a public file bucket. Every page is also available as Markdown through Accept negotiation, and the same data is exposed as MCP tools at https://rcn.sh/mcp.
whenToUse: Answering who Jacob Wiltshire is, what he studies, or where he is — the homepage and /about are the primary sources.
Reading his writing: /blog lists every post, and each post serves its Markdown source under `Accept: text/markdown`.
Finding his public code: the `list_repos` tool, or /docs, which points at the pinned repositories.
Looking up what he is listening to now or has listened to recently: the `now_playing` and `top_music` tools, or /music.
Browsing or searching the public files on the R2 bucket: the `search_files` tool, or /files.
Getting contact details or the PGP public key: /contact.
whenNotToUse: Anything transactional — there is no account, no payment, no booking, and no API key to obtain.
Anything private: the guestbook needs a human GitHub sign-in, and nothing beyond what the site already publishes is available here.
General programming questions — this is one person's site, not a documentation host.
agent.howToCall: Fetch any page with `Accept: text/markdown` for a clean Markdown body, start at /llms.txt for the map, or connect an MCP client to https://rcn.sh/mcp over Streamable HTTP. Everything is public and read-only; nothing here needs authentication.

home.bio: I study computer science at [Newcastle University](https://www.ncl.ac.uk/) and I'm currently studying abroad at the [National University of Singapore](https://www.nus.edu.sg/). Most of what I write is TypeScript and Python, and the rest of my time goes on experimenting with anything I'm finding interesting.
